cells.quote: NKLM 2.0 did not specify time frames, but rather recommendations for the semester or academic year and the level of competence to be achieved regarding learning objectives. result.effect: 1,426 coded segments; 5 codes had no teaching content

cells.quote: NKLM 2.0 covers most of the competencies required for adequate preventive medical NC. O.outcome_detail: Simulation performance on shoulder dystocia diagnosis and emergency-treatment procedures

result.effect: 95.9% met the required performance standard; mean 38.5/45

cells.quote: Overall, 95.9% of the study participants met the required standards, i.e. achieved very good to adequate performance (Ø good) in simulation training.
cells.note: Single-group prospective study; students had not previously studied shoulder dystocia, whereas midwifery trainees had theoretical exposure but no practical application.
